correctness.rationale: The exact signed unordered cubical model has chain ranks 276,792,558 and D1D2=0. A complete finite-field elimination gives rank(D2 mod101)=504. There are 32 canonical seven-cycles and 152 disjoint pairs with exact vanishing torus boundaries. A rank-54 integer torus minor is +1, so rank(D2 over Q)<=504 and equality follows, while the unimodular square-coordinate projection proves an integral H2 basis. Exhaustive automorphism enumeration yields group order 32 and orbits 16,32,16,8,32,32,16. Every four-orbit combination has rank at most 53 modulo 2; an exact Smith computation for five orbits (0,1,2,3,5) has all 54 unit factors, and for three (1,3,4) has 51 units and 2,2,4. All assertions replay in the embedded verifier.

value.rationale: The unique cubic (3,7)-cage is a canonical extremal high-girth nonplanar graph with a small nontransitive symmetry group. Its shortest heptagons supply an intrinsically selected geometric generating family. Primitive top-degree torus generation, the minimal five-orbit threshold, and the index-16 rational-versus-integral obstruction answer distinct motivated homological questions invisible to numerical Betti ranks or general planar-generation theorems. The claim is limited to this natural finite graph, without inflating it into a general family result.
